brands.name: Griffin Surfboards
brands.short_description: Independent Mount Maunganui surfboards shaped by Jordan Griffin since 2016. Custom models built around the rider.

models.name: 2002 A Modern Throwback Thruster
models.description: 2002 – A Modern Throwback Thruster The 2002 is a refined thruster inspired by early 2000s performance boards — reimagined for modern surfing. Featuring a classic 2002-style rocker and outline , this board brings that raw, high-speed feel with updated flow and drive. Designed to be ridden around 4 inches longer than your standard shortboard, and ¾ to 1 inch narrower , the 2002 trims out clean and holds a line when things get steep and fast. The added length gives it extra paddle power and projection, while the sleeker width keeps it sharp and responsive off the tail. Perfect for surfers chasing down the wall, throwing big turns, and tapping into that stripped-back, no-frills performance…

models.name: Zimmer Pin Step Up
models.description: The Zimmer Pin Step Up is a high-performance twin fin built for advanced surfers looking to push their limits in the surf. Designed for speed, control, and flow, it blends classic lines with refined modern tweaks. The nose has been thinned out and more rocker added to suit steeper, more curved waves, while a slightly lower rail helps engage more easily and hold through critical turns. Combined with a rounded pin tail and twin fin setup, this board offers drive, control, and smooth rail-to-rail transitions in bigger surf. Key Features: Twin fin setup (FCS2 or Futures) Refined pin-tail for grip and control Thinner nose + added rocker for steeper, curved waves Lower rail for easier engagement…

models.name: Two Fun
models.description: The Two Fun Model is designed for surfers who crave a dynamic and fun ride, blending the best of speed and manoeuvrability. Featuring a unique twin-fin setup with a trailer fin, this board is perfect for those who love to carve smooth arcs while maintaining excellent drive and stability. Whether you're carving down the line or looking for a bit of extra hold in the pocket, the Two Fun Model delivers a versatile performance, ideal for a variety of wave conditions. Twin Fin + Trailer Fin Configuration: The twin fins provide responsive turning and fast acceleration, while the trailer fin enhances stability and control for sharper, more precise maneuvers. models.name: Zimmer Pin
models.description: The ZIMMER TWO PIN has really opened my and our team riders' minds as to what is possible on a twin fin. With maximum hold, this board has amazing drive and speed. The ZIMMER TWO PIN is a mix between the Keeler and the original Zimmer Twin. With a little added width and thickness for those not-so-perfect days. We have also pushed the fins a lot further back to give it the drive and hold as we've chucked out the stabilizer in the Zimmer Two Pin. The Zimmer Two pin is a perfect addition to any quiver. models.name: The Mixer
models.description: THE MIXER After years of riding the athlete log it was time for new feelings in hopes of a even better ride. I made up a few different concepts and sent them out to my trusted test pilots to get some feedback. It was an instant hit for all of them and only a few minor changes were made. I had taken the front end of the Athlete and mixed it with the width of the chalkboard and the tail end of the first love. We Flatted the rocker and made it a little less extreme in the concave and the belly roll. This log has also been on a diet with a lot of foam as we felt that logs don’t always have to be big fat-railed slugs. This log has amazing nose riding capabilities mixed with easy flowing turns…

models.name: Zimmer Pin XL
models.description: The Zimmer PIN XL has that fun twin feel but has enough hold and projection to free you from ever wishing for a third fin or trailer. Designed as an all-rounder, it helps you rip into anything from lame little waves to double overhead rifling walls. The rails are low, so most people ride the Zimmer PIN XL at least 1/8” -1/4” thicker than their shortboard . Glassing: 4x4x4x 4 tail patch or 4x4x6 Rocker: Flat rocker Concave: Single to a subtle double concave with V running through the fins and off the tail. Tail: Rounded pin Fins layout: Twin. models.description: The KEELER is a more refined version of the Happy Hour Keel Fish with a straighter outline and less volume all around. It still has all the speed you’ll ever want and they love some nice flowing surfing. You’ll probably never find a better down-the-line tube board. The KEELER is a perfect all-round board from 2 ft slop to 5 ft tubes. I believe you’ll love every moment on this board. models.name: Happy Hour Keel Fish
models.description: The HAPPY HOUR KEEL FISH is probably one of the fastest boards I’ve ever ridden, they love some nice flowing surfing. Big turns are not an issue and you’ll probably never find a better down-the-line tube board. The fish was born from a kneeboard so wants to be ridden as short as possible to really get the feeling it’s supposed to have. A classic shape that will never get old and a go-to board for almost every wave type.
